Brown Butter Cookies

These cookies are the reason the oven stays on all winter. Brown butter gives them a nutty depth.

Ingredients

  • 225 g butter
  • 200 g brown sugar
  • 2 eggs

Method

  1. Brown the butter and let it cool.
  2. Beat in the sugar and eggs.
  3. Fold in the flour, scoop, and bake at 180 C for 11 minutes.
